method.wave_model: JONSWAP scaled on the synthesis grid to m0=Hs^2/16
method.synthesis: random-phase linear superposition using interpolated complex HAMS deck-point RAOs and an inverse real FFT

scope_boundary.included: Correlated linear wave-frequency motion at the landing center and four registered foot points.
scope_boundary.excluded: No touchdown timing policy, landing threshold, plume, GNC, DP controller, Chrono contact, or rocket-platform feedback is included in this screening layer.

acceptance.claim: Numerically reproducible linear HAMS/JONSWAP deck-motion screening only.
acceptance.not_claimed: Coupled landing success probability or operational sea-state qualification.
